intends to complete a non‐brokered private placement offering at a price of $0.15 per unit.
The offering will be for a minimum of 10M units for gross proceeds of $1.50M, and up to a maximum of 20M units, for gross proceeds of up to $3M.

The net proceeds from the offering is expected to be used to pay a deposit for phase 1 clinical trials for the company's lead compound MB‐204, general and administrative expenses and for general working capital.

title: Marvel Biosciences announces non‑brokered private placement for up to $3M
